memory.content: LinkedIn outreach must run as the designated outreach profile only — never from the operator’s personal LinkedIn.

Auto-sends (new comment replies and DMs as the outreach profile) are capped at 10 per run; after that, report remaining names/URLs for the operator to send manually. Already-replied Notion Stage syncs do not count toward the 10.

Step 2 replies to lead comments on LinkedIn regardless of Notion Stage (including DM Sent); still never double-reply if the outreach profile already replied under that comment; do not downgrade Stage if already past Comment Replied.

Step 4: accept person connection requests only; Decline/Ignore (do not leave pending) page/company follows, newsletter follows, event invites, and any non-person invite; cap 50 accepts/run; no Notion writes.
Step 2: if Comment Text already contains an email, write it to Notion Email and reply with Set C (thanks / send ASAP); do not use Set A/B. Step 3 skips leads whose Email is already filled.
When doing LinkedIn browser work, send screenshots and short status updates along the way.
Step 1 final posts table must include per post: Date, Total comments, Comments scanned, Added to Notion, Short title, Link.
Step 3 (DM Send) reports must include a markdown table of every person auto-DM’d that run with Name, LinkedIn URL, template letter, and the exact DM text sent verbatim.

Daily pipeline schedule (Australia/Melbourne by default): Step 1 Track Comments 9:00pm, Step 2 Comment Replies 9:30pm, Step 3 DM Send 10:00pm, Step 4 Accept Connections 10:15pm. Stage flow: New → Comment Replied (1st)/(2nd/3rd) → DM Sent. Create-only leads into the operator’s Notion lead tracker.
This bot uses Notion for the lead board and Apify (harvestapi LinkedIn post/comment actors) for Step 1 scraping. LinkedIn actions run in the bot browser signed in as the outreach profile.

skills.name: Psyke LinkedIn lead pipeline
skills.description: Use when running LinkedIn comment-tracking → reply → DM → accept-connections into a Notion lead tracker.
skills.content:
---
name: Psyke LinkedIn lead pipeline
description: >-
  Use when running LinkedIn comment-tracking → reply → DM → accept-connections
  into a Notion lead tracker.
---
# LinkedIn lead pipeline (4 stages)

Use when running an outreach LinkedIn profile’s comment → Notion lead tracker → reply → DM → accept connections flow.

## Shared facts
- Outreach profile: {{OUTREACH_LINKEDIN_PROFILE_URL}}
- Active board: the operator’s Notion lead tracker {{NOTION_LEAD_TRACKER_COLLECTION}} ({{NOTION_LEAD_TRACKER_URL}})
- Reply/DM/accept as the outreach profile only — never the operator’s personal LinkedIn
- Create-only for new leads; never update Notes/Email/Next Action except as a stage script allows (Stage B may write Email when found in the comment)
- Normalise LinkedIn URLs: lowercase `/in/<slug>` only
- **Auto-send cap:** at most **10 new comment replies** and **10 DMs** per run. After the cap, stop sending and list remaining people (name + LinkedIn URL + post) for the operator to message manually. Already-replied Notion Stage syncs do not count toward the reply cap.

## Stage A — Track comments
1. Compute lookback from newest Comment Date on the board (overlap prior runs; floor 72h; max 30d; posts window ≥14d).
2. Pull outreach-profile posts in window + comments (prefer Apify actors `harvestapi/linkedin-profile-posts` then `harvestapi/linkedin-post-comments` if available; skip if offline, no browser fallback). Never use cookie-based scrapers.
3. Filter to window; dedupe vs board; one row per person (most recent comment).
4. Include genuine interest; skip bots, pitches, pure congrats, the outreach profile itself.
5. Create ≤30 rows: Name, LinkedIn URL, Job Position, Company (parse or blank), Comment Date, Comment Text, Stage=`New`, Source URL=post URL, Post Title.
6. Final report posts table MUST include per post: Date | Total comments | Comments scanned | Added to Notion | Short title | Link (including 0-comment skips). Quiet one-liner if nothing new.

## Stage B — Comment replies
1. Eligible = any board lead with Source URL + Comment Text, **any Notion Stage** (including DM Sent). Skip only the outreach profile.
2. Verify LinkedIn session is the outreach profile before any reply.
3. LinkedIn is source of truth: if the outreach profile already replied under that comment, do not post again.
4. **Email-in-comment path:** if Comment Text contains a clear email address:
   - Write that email into the Notion **Email** property.
   - Reply with **Set C** (thanks / send ASAP) — pick **1 of 3 at random**. Do **not** use Set A/B.
   - Counts toward the 10-reply send cap.
5. Else: reply once with Set A (1st) or Set B (2nd/3rd); pick **1 of 3 at random**.
6. Stage updates: if Stage is New/blank after reply or already-replied sync → set Comment Replied (1st)/(2nd/3rd). If Stage is already Comment Replied / DM Sent / further → **do not downgrade**.
7. Caps: **10 new replies/run**; stop after 3 consecutive reply failures. After 10 sends, list remaining people still missing an outreach reply for the operator.
8. Never DM, connect, or open inbox in this stage.

### Step 2 reply templates (pick 1 of 3 at random; [Name]=first name)
**Set A — 1st degree (ask for a DM)**
1. Hey [Name], shoot me a DM with your email and which one you're after and I'll send it over ASAP
2. Hi [Name], DM me your email + which one you want and I'll get it across :)
3. Happy to send it over! DM me your email and the one you're after and will send it through ASAP!

**Set B — 2nd/3rd (ask to connect)**
1. Hey [Name], send me a connection request and DM me your email, I'll send it straight over once it's through.
2. Happy to share! Shoot a connection request my way and I'll get it to you ASAP.
3. Would love to send it. Could you connect first so I can DM you :)

**Set C — email already in their comment**
1. Thanks [Name], I'll send it over to you ASAP!
2. Got it [Name] — thanks, I'll send it through ASAP!
3. Thanks! I'll get it across to you ASAP :)

## Stage C — DM send
1. Eligible = Stage `Comment Replied (1st)` with LinkedIn URL. **Skip if Notion Email is already filled**.
2. As the outreach profile, pick **1 of 3** DM templates at random asking for email — no magnet in DM. Cap **10 DMs/run**.
3. After send: Stage=`DM Sent`, DM Sent Date=today, DM Text=sent copy.
4. After 10 sends, STOP and list remaining Comment Replied (1st) without Email for the operator.
5. Only skip: missing URL, unusable post title, unparseable name, **or Email already present**.
6. **Report must include a sent table**: Name | LinkedIn URL | Template (1/2/3) | Exact DM sent (verbatim).

### Step 3 DM templates (pick 1 of 3 at random; [Name]=first name; {post}=short post title)
1. Hey [Name], thanks for the comment on the {post} post. Happy to send it over, what's the best email?
2. Hey [Name], saw your comment on the {post} post. I'll send it across ASAP, what email works best?
3. Hey [Name], appreciate the comment on the {post} post. Drop me your email and I'll send it through :)

## Stage D — Accept connections
1. Verify LinkedIn is the outreach profile before any Accept or Decline.
2. Open My Network → received invitations / connection requests.
3. **Accept** only person-to-person connection requests.
4. **Decline / Ignore** (do not leave pending) page/company follow invites, newsletter follows, event invites, and any non-person invite.
5. Cap 50 accepts/run; no Notion writes; no messages or outbound connects.
6. Mini report: accepted (names or count), declined with reason, leftovers, errors. Quiet if none.

## Fail closed
If Notion board unreachable or LinkedIn is not the outreach profile: report and stop. Do not write fake progress.

routines.name: Step 1: Track Comments
routines.description: Daily 9:00pm Melbourne — scrape outreach-profile post comments into Notion as new leads.
routines.content:
Run Stage A of the LinkedIn lead pipeline skill ([Psyke LinkedIn lead pipeline](sand-workflow:psyke-linkedin-lead-pipeline)).

Goal: find new people commenting on the outreach LinkedIn profile’s posts (last ~14 days of posts) and create-only add genuine-interest leads to your Notion lead tracker.

Board: {{NOTION_LEAD_TRACKER_COLLECTION}}
DB URL: {{NOTION_LEAD_TRACKER_URL}}

Property mapping for creates:
- Name, LinkedIn URL, Job Position, Company, Comment Text
- Comment Date (datetime)
- Stage = New
- Source URL = post URL (REQUIRED — LinkedIn post they commented on)
- Post Title = short post title if known
- Owned by = operator when applicable
Never write Notes, Email, or Next Action on create.

Tools: prefer Apify actors harvestapi/linkedin-profile-posts then harvestapi/linkedin-post-comments. Use the operator’s Notion workspace only. Apify when available — skip if offline, no browser fallback for scraping. Never use cookie-based scrapers.

Skip list: only the outreach profile itself.

Reporting (required):
- Progress updates at each major beat.
- After posts fetched, ALWAYS show a markdown posts table:
  | Date | Total comments | Comments scanned | Added to Notion | Short title | Link |
- Mini report: lookback, posts, comments, new rows (names + source post), dedupe hits, skipped noise, errors.

Follow Stage A rules (lookback overlap, URL normalisation, dedupe, interest judgment, ≤30 create cap unless raised for a catch-up, create-only).

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Australia/Melbourne 0 21 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Step 2: Comment Replies
routines.description: Daily 9:30pm Melbourne — public comment replies (Sets A/B/C) with a 10-reply cap.
routines.content:
Run Stage B of the LinkedIn lead pipeline skill ([Psyke LinkedIn lead pipeline](sand-workflow:psyke-linkedin-lead-pipeline)).

Goal: as the outreach LinkedIn profile only, reply publicly under lead-magnet comments whenever that profile has not yet replied — regardless of Notion Stage. Never DM, never connect, never open inbox, never send the magnet in this step.

Board: {{NOTION_LEAD_TRACKER_COLLECTION}}
DB: {{NOTION_LEAD_TRACKER_URL}}

Pull leads with a Source URL + Comment Text (any Stage). Skip only the outreach profile. Prefer newest Comment Date first.

{slack_channel_id} — LinkedIn is the source of truth:
- If the outreach profile already replied under that comment, SKIP posting.
- If Stage is still New/blank and they already replied, sync Stage to Comment Replied (1st) or (2nd/3rd) by degree. Already-replied syncs do NOT count toward the send cap.
- If Stage is already Comment Replied / DM Sent / further: do NOT downgrade Stage.
- Only post a new reply when there is no outreach-profile reply yet.

EMAIL-IN-{slack_channel_id_2}:
- If Comment Text contains a clear email, write it to Notion Email, then reply with Set C. Do not ask for email, DM, or connection.
- Else use Set A (1st) or Set B (2nd/3rd).

TEMPLATES — pick 1 of 3 at random; [Name]=first name:

Set A — 1st degree:
1. Hey [Name], shoot me a DM with your email and which one you're after and I'll send it over ASAP
2. Hi [Name], DM me your email + which one you want and I'll get it across :)
3. Happy to send it over! DM me your email and the one you're after and will send it through ASAP!

Set B — 2nd/3rd:
1. Hey [Name], send me a connection request and DM me your email, I'll send it straight over once it's through.
2. Happy to share! Shoot a connection request my way and I'll get it to you ASAP.
3. Would love to send it. Could you connect first so I can DM you :)

Set C — email already in comment:
1. Thanks [Name], I'll send it over to you ASAP!
2. Got it [Name] — thanks, I'll send it through ASAP!
3. Thanks! I'll get it across to you ASAP :)

SEND CAP: at most 10 new replies per run; then list remaining for the operator to do manually.

Before any reply: verify LinkedIn is signed in as the outreach profile. If not, stop and report.

Reporting: progress + screenshots; mini report with exact reply text, Stage before/after, Email enrichment, skips, remaining, errors. One reply per person; stop after 3 consecutive failures.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Australia/Melbourne 30 21 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
- Slack channel id

routines.name: Step 3: DM Send
routines.description: Daily 10:00pm Melbourne — DM Comment Replied (1st) leads for email (cap 10; skip if Email filled).
routines.content:
Run Stage C of the LinkedIn lead pipeline skill ([Psyke LinkedIn lead pipeline](sand-workflow:psyke-linkedin-lead-pipeline)).

Goal: as the outreach LinkedIn profile only, DM people at Stage="Comment Replied (1st)" asking for their email (no magnet in the DM), then set Stage=DM Sent, DM Sent Date=today, DM Text=sent copy.

Board: {{NOTION_LEAD_TRACKER_COLLECTION}}
DB: {{NOTION_LEAD_TRACKER_URL}}

Skip if Notion Email is already filled — do not DM them asking for email again.

Use Post Title for {post}. Pick 1 of 3 templates at random; [Name]=first name:

1. Hey [Name], thanks for the comment on the {post} post. Happy to send it over, what's the best email?
2. Hey [Name], saw your comment on the {post} post. I'll send it across ASAP, what email works best?
3. Hey [Name], appreciate the comment on the {post} post. Drop me your email and I'll send it through :)

SEND CAP: at most 10 DMs per run. After 10 confirmed sends, STOP and list remaining Comment Replied (1st) without Email for the operator. Only move Stage after a confirmed send.

Reporting: progress beats; mini report X sent / Y skipped / remaining / errors; required sent table: Name | LinkedIn URL | Template (1/2/3) | Exact DM sent (verbatim).

Verify LinkedIn is the outreach profile before sending. Only skip: missing LinkedIn URL, unusable Post Title, unparseable name, or Email already present.
Never create/delete rows; only Comment Replied (1st) → DM Sent after confirmed send.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Australia/Melbourne 0 22 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Step 4: Accept Connections
routines.description: Daily 10:15pm Melbourne — accept person connection requests; decline page/newsletter/event invites.
routines.content:
Run Stage D of the LinkedIn lead pipeline skill ([Psyke LinkedIn lead pipeline](sand-workflow:psyke-linkedin-lead-pipeline)).

Goal: as the outreach LinkedIn profile only, accept pending person connection requests. Decline/Ignore (do not leave pending) page follows, company/page invites, newsletter follows, event invites, and any non-person invite.

Steps:
1. Verify LinkedIn is signed in as the outreach profile. If not, stop and report.
2. Open My Network → Invitations / connection requests (Received).
3. For each pending invitation: ACCEPT person connects; DECLINE/IGNORE non-person invites.
4. Cap accepts at 50/run; no Notion writes; no messages or outbound Connects.

Reporting: account confirmed, N accepted (names if ≤20 else count + sample), M declined with reason, leftovers, errors. Quiet one-liner if zero pending. Screenshots + short progress while browser work runs.

Fail closed if not the outreach profile.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Australia/Melbourne 15 22 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
